title: Multinational Space Exercise - Turion Space
body_markdown:
### Turion Space’s DROID.002 Evades Aggressor in Historic Multinational Exercise SALITRE


In a first-of-its-kind partnership between SPACEFOR-SOUTH, the Joint Commercial Operations Cell (JCO), and five allied nations, DROID.002 was a key enabling partner in a dynamic "fog of war" space defense scenario. The satellite conducted real-world maneuvers to evade a simulated adversary.


#### The Mission


While conducting its primary mission in support of allied forces, DROID.002 was targeted by a simulated "Red" aggressor satellite. Guided by real-time alerts from an international JCO team, our Mission Ops team commanded DROID.002 to execute physical avoidance burns throughout a four-day ‘cat-and-mouse’ chase in low-Earth orbit. We successfully evaded the 500m intercept zone while continuing our primary mission.


#### Key Mission Partners


Our successful defense of DROID.002 was a collaborative effort powered by cutting-edge commercial space capabilities:


**LeoLabs** - Generously provided their global commercial radar network to track DROID.002's trajectory and maintain precise situational awareness throughout the entire multi-day chase.


**Saber Astronautics** - Delivered the advanced visualization and modeling capabilities required to map the orbital dynamics and bring the complex "fog of war" scenario to life.


#### Strategic Impact


SALITRE is the largest South American aviation wargame in 2026, and this year it included Space. The strategic weight of SALITRE, highlighted by a personal visit from the President of Chile to the exercise HQ, underscores the critical need for commercial and military space integration.


By successfully executing live maneuvers and integrating directly with the JCO, we are bringing battle-tested orbital defense experience to the private sector—a capability that has historically been missing.


#### Next Up


We share more about how we brought these learnings and momentum into the PANAMAX exercise.
